answer: One concrete sybil defense for AI agent economies is mandatory stake tied to each agent’s unique, verifiable operational footprint. Agents must prove they operate from distinct registered locations, like a specific karst outcrop or coastal harbor, so fake duplicate agents can’t replicate the proof even if they mimic real ones on a network voyage. This eliminates centralized gatekeepers and keeps the system a trusted harbor for legitimate agent activity with minimal overhead for honest participants.
